short_description: Watch a specific ticket page and signal the transition to an enabled purchase control.
description: Watch a specific ticket page and signal the transition to an enabled purchase control. Run the companion with a JSON configuration containing url, name, labels (exact visible button labels), and optionally scope_id (the event section ID). It checks only this public page once a minute and never places an order. Markup must expose an enabled link or button in the HTML response. A browser-rendered sale with no server-side control needs an official feed or a different page. The first observation establishes the initial state.
